value: Act of 21 June 2001 on the protection of tenants' rights, the municipal housing stock and amending the Civil Code (consolidated text Dz.U. 2023 item 725), together with the Civil Code lease provisions.
note: Based on the 2023 consolidated text; later amendments were not reviewed.

value: A deposit securing the landlord's dues may not exceed twelve times the monthly rent calculated at the rent in force on the day the lease is concluded (art. 6(1)).
note: Based on the 2023 consolidated text; later amendments were not reviewed.

value: The deposit is returned within one month of the tenant vacating the dwelling, after deduction of the landlord's dues; a revalued amount may not be lower than the amount collected (art. 6(3)-(4)).

Landlord raises rent by terminating the existing rent amount in writing, with three months notice (longer if the lease says so), at the latest by the end of a calendar month; rent may not be raised more often than every six months (art. 8a(1)-(3), art. 9(1b)).

field: Rent above 3 percent of replacement value
value: An increase taking annual rent above 3 percent of the dwelling's replacement value is allowed only in justified cases listed in art. 8a(4a) and (4e); on written request the landlord must state the reason and calculation within 14 days (art. 8a(4)).

Where the tenant is entitled to use the dwelling for payment, the landlord may terminate only on statutory grounds and in writing stating the reason (art. 11(1)). For example, with one month notice to the end of a month where the tenant uses the dwelling contrary to the contract despite a written warning, or is in arrears for at least three full payment periods after a written warning and a one-month additional deadline (art. 11(2)).
